title: centaurea gabrieliae
intro: Centaurea gabrieliae, commonly known as Gabriel's Spike or Mountain Bluet, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is native to the mountainous regions of Greece and is traditionally used in folk medicine for its therapeutic properties. Centaurea gabrieliae is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
